notes.title: MASSIVE BUGFIXES AND SERVER UPGRADE
notes.notes:
We are sincerely grateful to everyone who played DOOMED Detective Game and reported issues and bugs, most of which we have fixed in this update. We did not expect such a huge influx of players, which caused our server to crash and respond with the now-iconic phrase, "I'm not in the mood to talk right now, come back later." This has practically become a local meme.

Now, we have strengthened our servers, and they can handle significantly more players than before. In addition, we have fixed several issues with achievements, cursor disappearing, and more.

We will continue to improve the game and hope that even those who were disappointed due to technical problems will be able to dive in and truly enjoy the unique gameplay focused on humor and logical thinking.

Thank you, and "I'm in the mood now, come right in!"
